stages.headline: Angles are measured in degrees; 1° is 1/180 of a straight angle, which is 180°. We use a protractor.
stages.headlineEnglish: Angles are measured in degrees; 1° is 1/180 of a straight angle, which is 180°. We use a protractor.

stages.headline: A 90° angle is right, less than 90° acute, between 90° and 180° obtuse.
stages.headlineEnglish: A 90° angle is right, less than 90° acute, between 90° and 180° obtuse.

stages.headline: If a ray divides an angle into two, the whole angle's measure equals the sum of the two measures.
